messages:
Kira M.: Heads-up — cost spike in eu-west on GPU usage. Roughly 18% of GPU hours this billing period show up as untagged / 'unassigned'. Link to query: https://console.cloud.redwood/costs?query=unassigned (redacted).
Samir: yikes. Is that at the instance level or node label level?
Mike (infra): looks like a node-pool rollout yesterday created some nodes without redwood.team label. Daemonsets attached fine but node metadata missing.
Anya: we can’t retroactively change cloud-tag billing for past invoices. We'll need an export join to attribute historical usage before we bill teams.
Kira M.: Proposal: 1) Backfill node and PV labels where possible; 2) Re-run billing export join to attribute historical usage; 3) Evaluate reserved/committed capacity for eu-west (1yr) if utilization >= ~75%. Quick calc attached in thread.
Samir: For (2) — my chargeback pipeline can accept gce_instance_id join. If we can produce a mapping CSV of instance_id -> team, I can redistribute costs.
Mike (infra): I can run a DaemonSet that tags nodes and annotate volumes, but it requires rolling drains. Plan: cordon+drain up to 5 nodes at once in eu-west to avoid perf impact. Need approval from owners.
BillingBot: Invoice alert: 2026-02 invoice shows 18.9% untagged compute in eu-west. Suggested action: `/billing backfill --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-02-28 --group-by team`
DevEx: opened mutating webhook PR to enforce label default: https://git.internal/redwood/devops/pulls/456 — automatically sets `redwood.team=unassigned` if missing.
Anya: reminder: even if we backfill metadata, cloud provider invoices won't change. Finance wants an auditable trail in the chargeback sheet (CSV + join). Legal wants the methodology documented.
Kira M.: Understood. Implementation steps: run backfill, generate mapping, run chargeback dry-run, then allocate untagged proportionally to active teams + flag top 3 consumers for manual review. Also compute commitment ROI. Example SQL I ran for attribution: ```SELECT COALESCE(labels['redwood.team'], 'unassigned') AS team, SUM(usage_hours) AS hours FROM billing_export WHERE region='eu-west' AND sku LIKE '%GPU%' GROUP BY team;```
Samir: can add commitment_utilization metric to infra dashboard. Also recommend enforcing labels at pod admission (OPA) to catch infra/service accounts creating unlabeled instances.
Mike (infra): I'll open infra ticket with rollout plan, and can start the backfill today EOD. Will announce maintenance window.
Anya: For the historical allocation, I prefer proportional allocation based on active hours rather than a lump-sum 'unassigned' bucket. That preserves fairness for teams with intermittent spikes. Will need CSV with columns: team, hours, attributed_cost, evidence_link.
Kira M.: Agreed. Samir — can you run the dry-run and drop the CSV to /shared/finance/chargeback/2026-02-attribution.csv and ping here? After dry-run we'll decide on commitment purchase.
Samir: starting dry-run now. Quick snippet of the join I run: ```# pseudo
SELECT be.instance_id, be.usage_hours, m.team
FROM billing_export be
LEFT JOIN instance_metadata m ON be.instance_id = m.id
WHERE be.region='eu-west' AND be.sku LIKE '%GPU%';
```
Samir: Dry-run complete. Summary: after backfill attribution, projected eu-west GPU utilization for steady workloads is ~78%, which makes a 1yr reserved commitment pay off (~$12.3k/mo estimated savings). Attaching short CSV to the shared drive. Will post link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
Kira M.: Nice. If infra can backfill without data loss and DevEx webhook reduces future noise, finance comfortable moving forward. Next steps: Mike schedule maintenance, Samir final CSV, Anya to document methodology in the chargeback README, and I'll prepare commitment purchase request if numbers hold.
Mike (infra): scheduled cordon/drain for eu-west pool 2 tonight 22:00 UTC. Will monitor rollout.
BillingBot: Backfill job queued by Samir (job-id: bf-7723).
Samir: Uploaded CSV: /shared/finance/chargeback/2026-02-attribution.csv — dry-run columns: team,hours,attributed_cost,evidence_link. Filing PR to chargeback repo to accept this input format.
Anya: thanks — once we have the final numbers I’ll update the internal invoice memo.
Kira M.: Great work everyone. After commit purchase we should add an automation to alert when utilization <70% for 2 consecutive weeks so we can consider scale-back. :eyes:
